<details><summary>AI feedback</summary>

Proposed fixes for defects D1 and D2 aren't applied yet.

D1: When `update document for history step application` reuses an existing `navigation`'s `activation` on BFCache reactivation (for example, cross-origin or non-contiguous same-origin BFCache restoration where `previousEntryIndex` is negative and `navigationType` is `"traverse"` rather than `"replace"`), missing an `Otherwise` branch leaves `activation`'s `old entry` (`navigation.activation.from`) set to its prior value instead of `null`.
Not applied: [proposed fix (spec)](https://github.com/noamr/html/commit/57fea33), [proposed fix (test)](https://github.com/noamr/wpt/commit/185516d)

D2: No WPT checks `navigation.activation === savedActivation` across BFCache reactivation, and `navigation_committed.py` only tests initial `<iframe src>` loading during a top-level navigation rather than navigating an existing child iframe directly.
Not applied: [proposed fix](https://github.com/noamr/wpt/commit/cac67cd)

<details><summary>Reviewed commits</summary>

Reviewed at 8252a15 on 0e292f4, with web-platform-tests/wpt@90d3906, using spec-pr-review.
</details>
</details>
